description: React functional component 'GuardrailSelector' that allows users to select guardrails. It fetches guardrail options from an API, manages loading state, and passes selected values via a callback.

methods.name: GuardrailSelector
methods.description: React functional component using hooks to display a multi-select dropdown for guardrails, fetching options asynchronously.

methods.name: fetchGuardrails
methods.description: Asynchronous function called in useEffect to fetch guardrails from API and update state.

methods.name: handleGuardrailChange
methods.description: Event handler to process selection changes and propagate via onChange callback.
